~~~text
export function AppHeader() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation()
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    setMenuOpen(false)
  }, [pathname])

  const closeMenu = useCallback(() => setMenuOpen(false), [])
  useScrollLock(menuOpen)
  useEscapeKey(menuOpen, () => {
    setMenuOpen(false)
    toggleRef.current?.focus()
  })

  return (
    <>
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 h-(--ui-header-height) border-b border-default bg-default/85 backdrop-blur-lg">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-(--ui-container) items-center gap-4 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center">
            <BrandLink />
          </div>
          <DesktopNav items={headerNav} pathname={pathname} />
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-end">
            <button
              ref={toggleRef}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              aria-controls="mobile-menu"
              aria-label={menuOpen ? '收起菜单' : '展开菜单'}
              className="-mr-1.5 inline-flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-default transition-colors hover:bg-elevated lg:hidden"
            >
              {menuOpen ? <X aria-hidden className="size-5" /> : <Menu aria-hidden className="size-5" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <MobileMenu open={menuOpen} items={headerNav} pathname={pathname} onClose={closeMenu} />
    </>
  )
}
~~~

~~~text
const tmp=load("figmaT017Tmp");
const origin=`http://127.0.0.1:${load("figmaT017Port")}`;
const script=String.raw`import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { chromium } from "playwright-core";

const origin = process.argv[1];
const collections = {
  frontend: ["component-scaffold", "design-tokens", "accessibility-audit"],
  workflow: ["spec-planning", "code-review", "release-notes"],
};
const collectionNames = Object.keys(collections);
const folderStates = [[], ["frontend"], ["workflow"], ["frontend","workflow"]];
const views = [
  {view:"首页 Skills", path:"/", chapter:"skills"},
  {view:"首页 MCP", path:"/", chapter:"mcp"},
  {view:"技能文档总览", path:"/skills", heading:"技能文档"},
  ...Object.entries(collections).flatMap(([group,skills]) => [
    {view:group+" 集合", path:"/skills/"+group, heading:group, group},
    ...skills.map(skill => ({view:skill, path:"/skills/"+group+"/"+skill, heading:skill, group}))
  ]),
  {view:"MCP 文档", path:"/mcp", heading:"MCP 文档"},
  {view:"Spec Kit 栏目 A", path:"/spec-kit/section-a", heading:"栏目 A", text:"这里是栏目 A 的占位正文"},
  {view:"Spec Kit 栏目 B", path:"/spec-kit/section-b", heading:"栏目 B", text:"这里是栏目 B 的占位正文"},
  {view:"项目开发文档", path:"/development", heading:"项目开发文档"},
];
const executablePath="/home/ena/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell";

async function expectExpanded(page, button, expanded) {
  const controls = await button.getAttribute("aria-controls");
  assert.ok(controls);
  await page.waitForFunction(({controls,expanded}) => {
    const button = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("button[aria-controls]")).find(node=>node.getAttribute("aria-controls")===controls);
    return button?.getAttribute("aria-expanded")===String(expanded);
  },{controls,expanded});
  const panel = page.locator("[id="+JSON.stringify(controls)+"]");
  await panel.waitFor({state:expanded?"visible":"attached"});
  await page.waitForFunction(({controls,expanded}) => {
    const panel = document.getElementById(controls);
    return panel && panel.inert === !expanded;
  },{controls,expanded});
  return panel;
}

async function expectGroupGeometry(page, id, expanded) {
  await page.waitForFunction(({id,expanded}) => {
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!panel) return false;
    const height=panel.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    return expanded ? height>20 : height<1;
  },{id,expanded});
}

async function expectLinks(scope, paths, message) {
  const actual = await scope.locator("a[href]").evaluateAll(nodes=>nodes.map(n=>n.getAttribute("href")));
  for (const path of paths) assert.ok(actual.includes(path), message+": "+path);
}

async function fillTree(page, tree, prefix, open) {
  for (const group of collectionNames) {
    const id=prefix+"-"+group;
    const toggle=tree.locator('button[aria-controls="'+id+'"]');
    const desired=open.includes(group);
    if ((await toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded")==="true") !== desired) await toggle.click();
    const branch=await expectExpanded(page,toggle,desired);
    await expectGroupGeometry(page,id,desired);
    if (desired) await expectLinks(branch,collections[group].map(skill=>"/skills/"+group+"/"+skill),"技能目录项");
  }
}

async function checkCurrent(tree, path) {
  assert.equal(await tree.locator('a[aria-current="page"]').getAttribute("href"),path);
}

async function reachView(page, view, mobile) {
  const response=await page.goto(origin+view.path,{waitUntil:"domcontentloaded",timeout:15000});
  assert.equal(response.status(),200);
  assert.equal(new URL(page.url()).pathname,view.path);
  await page.locator("main h1").waitFor({state:"attached"});
  const heading=(await page.locator("main h1").textContent()).trim();
  if (!view.chapter) {
    assert.equal(heading,view.heading);
    if (view.text) assert.ok((await page.locator("main").innerText()).includes(view.text));
    return {heading};
  }
  if (view.chapter === "mcp") {
    const tab=page.locator("section[data-index='0'] nav[aria-label='章节'] button").nth(1);
    if (mobile) await tab.tap();
    else await tab.click();
  }
  const region=page.locator("section[aria-labelledby='chapter-"+view.chapter+"']");
  await page.waitForFunction(chapter=>{
    const section=document.querySelector("section[aria-labelledby='chapter-"+chapter+"']");
    const parent=section?.parentElement;
    return section?.dataset.revealed==="true" && parent && Math.abs(section.getBoundingClientRect().top-parent.getBoundingClientRect().top)<8;
  },view.chapter);
  const chapterHeading=(await region.locator("h2").textContent()).trim();
  assert.equal(chapterHeading,view.chapter==="mcp"?"MCP":"Skills");
  const model=(await region.locator("figcaption").innerText()).replace(/\n+/g," / ");
  return {heading:chapterHeading,model};
}

async function desktopPopup(page) {
  const navbar=page.locator('header nav[aria-label="主导航"]');
  const trigger=navbar.getByRole("button",{name:"技能文档",exact:true});
  assert.equal(await trigger.getAttribute("aria-expanded"),"false");
  await trigger.press("Enter");
  const panel=await expectExpanded(page,trigger,true);
  await expectLinks(panel,["/skills",...collectionNames.map(group=>"/skills/"+group)],"桌面技能集合");
  await expectLinks(navbar,["/mcp","/spec-kit/section-a","/development"],"桌面主导航");
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expectExpanded(page,trigger,false);
}

async function mobileMenu(page) {
  const trigger=page.locator('button[aria-controls="mobile-menu"]');
  assert.equal(await trigger.getAttribute("aria-expanded"),"false");
  await trigger.tap();
  const menu=await expectExpanded(page,trigger,true);
  const skill=menu.locator('button[aria-controls="mobile-menu-skills"]');
  const group=await expectExpanded(page,skill,true);
  await expectGroupGeometry(page,"mobile-menu-skills",true);
  await expectLinks(group,["/skills",...collectionNames.map(group=>"/skills/"+group)],"手机技能集合");
  await expectLinks(menu,["/mcp","/spec-kit/section-a","/development"],"手机主导航");
  await skill.tap();
  await expectExpanded(page,skill,false);
  await expectGroupGeometry(page,"mobile-menu-skills",false);
  await trigger.tap();
  await expectExpanded(page,trigger,false);
  await menu.waitFor({state:"hidden"});
}

async function inspectViewport(browser, viewport, mobile) {
  const context=await browser.newContext({viewport,isMobile:mobile,hasTouch:mobile});
  const page=await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(6000);
  const errors=[];
  page.on("pageerror",error=>errors.push(error.message.slice(0,200)));
  const cases=[];
  try {
    for (const view of views) {
      const path=view.path;
      const skills=path==="/skills" || path.startsWith("/skills/");
      let stage="默认画面";
      try {
        const display=await reachView(page,view,mobile);
        let states=mobile?3:2;
        const initial=(view.group?[view.group]:[]).join(",")||"两组折叠";
        if (mobile) {
          stage="顶部菜单及技能子菜单";
          await mobileMenu(page);
          if (skills) {
            stage="目录抽屉";
            const button=page.locator('button[aria-controls="skills-drawer"]');
            assert.equal(await button.getAttribute("aria-expanded"),"false");
            await button.tap();
            const drawer=await expectExpanded(page,button,true);
            await checkCurrent(drawer,path);
            for (const combination of folderStates) {
              await fillTree(page,drawer,"drawer",combination);
              states=states+1;
            }
            await drawer.getByRole("button",{name:"收起目录"}).tap();
            await expectExpanded(page,button,false);
            await drawer.waitFor({state:"hidden"});
          }
        } else if (skills) {
          stage="桌面侧栏与顶部菜单";
          const tree=page.locator('aside[aria-label="技能目录"]');
          await tree.waitFor({state:"visible"});
          await checkCurrent(tree,path);
          states=0;
          for (const combination of folderStates) {
            await fillTree(page,tree,"aside",combination);
            await desktopPopup(page);
            states=states+2;
          }
        } else {
          stage="桌面顶部菜单";
          await desktopPopup(page);
        }
        if (view.text) {
          const nav=mobile?page.locator('nav[aria-label="与 Spec Kit 协作栏目"]'):page.locator('aside[aria-label="栏目导航"]');
          await nav.waitFor({state:"visible"});
          const current=nav.locator('a[aria-current="page"]');
          assert.equal(await current.getAttribute("href"),path);
          await expectLinks(nav,["/spec-kit/section-a","/spec-kit/section-b"],"Spec Kit 栏目");
        }
        cases.push({view:view.view,path,...display,states,...(skills?{initial}:{})});
      } catch (error) {
        cases.push({view:view.view,path,stage,error:error.message.slice(0,400)});
      }
    }
  } finally {
    await context.close();
  }
  return {viewport,mobile,cases,errors:[...new Set(errors)]};
}

const browser=await chromium.launch({executablePath,headless:true});
try {
  const results=await Promise.all([
    inspectViewport(browser,{width:1440,height:900},false),
    inspectViewport(browser,{width:390,height:844},true)
  ]);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({chromium:browser.version(),results}));
  if (results.some(result=> result.cases.some(item=>item.error))) process.exitCode=1;
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}`;
store("figmaT017AuditScript",script);
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replace(/'/g,"'\\''")+"'";
const cmd=`mise exec node@24.22.2 -- node --input-type=module -e ${quote(script)} ${quote(origin)}`;
const result=await tools.exec_command({cmd,workdir:tmp+"/browser",max_output_tokens:6200,yield_time_ms:1000});
if(result.session_id) store("figmaT017AuditSession",result.session_id);
else store("figmaT017AuditResult",result);
text(result);
~~~

~~~text
---
name: verification-before-completion
description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
---

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
❌ Trust agent report
```

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness
~~~

~~~text
export function Drawer({ id, open, title, onClose, children }: DrawerProps) {
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useScrollLock(open)
  useEscapeKey(open, onClose)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
    panelRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    return () => previous?.focus?.({ preventScroll: true })
  }, [open])

  return (
    <div inert={!open} className={cn('fixed inset-0 z-[60] transition-[visibility] duration-300 lg:hidden', open ? 'visible' : 'invisible')}>
      <div aria-hidden onClick={onClose} className={cn('absolute inset-0 bg-ink/40 backdrop-blur-[2px] transition-opacity duration-300', open ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')} />
      <div
        ref={panelRef}
        id={id}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        tabIndex={-1}
        className={cn(
          'absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex w-[min(20rem,86vw)] flex-col bg-default shadow-2xl outline-none transition-transform duration-300 ease-out-expo',
          open ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full',
        )}
      >
        <div className="flex h-(--ui-header-height) shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-default px-4">
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-highlighted">{title}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="收起目录"
            className="-mr-1.5 inline-flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-elevated hover:text-highlighted"
          >
            <X aria-hidden className="size-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-5">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
            showLive ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0',
          )}
        >
          <Rotate3d className="size-3.5" />
          拖动旋转
        </span>
      </div>
      <figcaption className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-[11px] leading-5 lg:mt-3">
        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="shrink-0 font-mono tracking-[0.16em] text-dimmed">FIG. {number}</span>
          <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-toned">{figure.title}</span>
          <span className="hidden truncate text-muted xl:inline">— {figure.caption}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="flex min-w-0 shrink items-center gap-1.5 text-muted" aria-live="polite">
          <span aria-hidden className={cn('size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full', showLive ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-current opacity-50')} />
          <span className="truncate">{status}</span>
        </span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  )
}
~~~

~~~text
 * Chapter illustration: the static preview acts as the poster and fallback; the live
 * Three.js canvas cross-fades in on top once its first frame has rendered.
 */
export function ModelFigure({ kind, number, figure, active, className }: ModelFigureProps) {
  const { mode, staticReason, reportIssue } = useRenderMode()
  const live = mode === 'live'
  const liveHostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const sceneRef = useRef<SceneHandle | null>(null)
  const activeRef = useRef(active)
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const host = liveHostRef.current
    if (!live || !host) return
    let cancelled = false
    let scene: SceneHandle | null = null
    // A fresh canvas per mount: a disposed renderer leaves its WebGL context lost.
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
    canvas.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:pan-y;cursor:grab'
    host.appendChild(canvas)

    sceneLoaders[kind]().then(
      ({ createScene }) => {
        if (cancelled) return
        try {
          scene = createScene(canvas, {
            onFirstFrame: () => {
              if (!cancelled) setReady(true)
            },
            onFailure: (reason) => {
              if (!cancelled) reportIssue(reason)
            },
          })
          scene.setActive(activeRef.current)
          sceneRef.current = scene
        } catch {
          reportIssue('3D 场景初始化失败')
        }
      },
      () => {
        if (!cancelled) reportIssue('3D 模块加载失败')
      },
    )

    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      scene?.dispose()
      sceneRef.current = null
      canvas.remove()
      setReady(false)
    }
  }, [live, kind, reportIssue])

  useEffect(() => {
    activeRef.current = active
    sceneRef.current?.setActive(active)
  }, [active])

  const showLive = live && ready
  const status = showLive ? '实时渲染 · Three.js' : live ? '正在载入 3D…' : staticReason ? `静态预览 · ${staticReason}` : '静态预览'
  const Preview = previews[kind]

  return (
    <figure className={cn('relative flex min-h-0 flex-col', className)}>
      <div role="img" aria-label={figure.label} className="relative min-h-0 flex-1">
        <CropMarks />
        <div aria-hidden className={cn('absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-700', showLive ? 'opacity-0' : 'opacity-100')}>
~~~

~~~text
## Figma 转换清单项及验收

| 字段               | 含义                                     | 约束                                                               |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 原型模块/页面/视图 | 指向实际原型可达项                       | 五个模块覆盖；不同正文的 Spec Kit 栏目分别列项                     |
| 视口               | 桌面、手机或该项适用的视口               | 与实际布局适配情况对应，不伪造不适用组合                           |
| 交互状态           | 默认画面或改变可见导航布局的展开态       | 手机全局菜单、技能集合子菜单、技能目录展开态按原型实际存在情况列项 |
| 具名画板引用       | 转换后 Design 文件中的目标               | 每个清单项唯一对应一个可定位画板                                   |
| 检查结果与差异     | 编辑性、正文/导航、字体图片、3D/动画核对 | 区分通过、失败、缺前置、未执行；替代须逐项记录并经设计协作者确认   |

该清单在拿到真实原型后生成或更新；当前缺输入及编辑权限，不能实例化实际页面项。

## 技能说明来源规则

正式导入按集合独立处理：文档字段省略或 `true` 读取集合默认 README；字符串读取该集合内指定文件；`false` 不读取说明；指定文件不存在时对该集合告警并显示占位，不能阻止其他有效集合。样例闭环不代表真实产物验收。
90:- [ ] T017 [P] [US6] 在 `specs/docs/001-docs-site-framework/analysis/figma-conversion.md` 建立真实原型盘点和输入记录；取得可访问的 Figma Make 原型或可运行源码、以及可编辑目标 Design 文件/工作区权限后，逐项记录五模块可达页面/视图、适用桌面/手机视口、默认画面、改变可见导航布局的展开态和不同正文的 Spec Kit 栏目。缺任何前置时记录阻塞原因与恢复条件。 [实施方案](implementation/T017.md)
~~~

~~~text
### 可见导航状态

下列规则与上表每一行组成可复现的清单项。画板名称可用「视图 · 视口 · 状态」，基准组合命名为「默认」。例如「frontend 集合 · 手机 · 目录仅展开 frontend」。每个视图有一项桌面默认画面和一项手机默认画面。

| --- | --- | --- |

| 手机，所有视图 | 顶部菜单关闭，或打开且技能集合展开，或打开且技能集合折叠。点击「展开菜单」时技能集合默认展开，点击菜单内「技能文档」切换，点击「收起菜单」关闭。 | 两个打开状态有不同高度和可见链接，四个文档模块仍可从菜单识别。 |
~~~

~~~text
| 手机，九个技能视图             | 在关闭顶部菜单后点「目录」，分别核对两组折叠、仅展开 frontend、仅展开 workflow、两组展开四种抽屉画面。点「收起目录」恢复默认。                   | 抽屉有独立的集合开合控件，打开时可见当前条目的选中状态。                                   |
| 两种视口，Spec Kit 栏目 A 和 B | 桌面使用「栏目导航」左侧栏，手机使用内容上方的横向栏目条。                                                                                       | 两个栏目各自有标题、正文和可定位的选中链接。                                               |

桌面的非技能视图有 2 项，技能视图有 4 种侧栏状态与 2 种下拉状态的 8 个组合。手机各视图有 3 种顶部菜单状态，技能视图另有 4 种目录抽屉状态。按表中规则共核对 165 个视口与导航组合，其中 30 项是默认画面。首页翻页和菜单开合等操作共用原路径，状态还需通过实际操作定位。

| --------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| 页面和导航盘点                    | 通过         | 逐项采集桌面 84 个组合和手机 81 个组合。汇总来自浏览器逐项运行和桌面首页的单项补测。                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 浏览器首轮运行                    | 失败，已复跑 | 浏览器连接器配置的 Chrome 不在本机。使用已安装 Chromium 后，首轮并行检查出现超时，改为按视口顺序执行。串行检查中桌面首页 Skills 首载仍有一次超时。此前单项检查已看到实时 Three.js 并操作了下拉，另以 `--disable-webgl` 补测了静态预览画面及同样的菜单操作。 |
~~~
